tools.name: get_near_earth_objects
tools.description: Get Near Earth Objects (asteroids) from NASA NeoWs. Returns asteroid data including size, hazard status, closest approach distance and velocity.

tools.name: get_space_weather
tools.description: Get space weather events from NASA DONKI. Includes solar flares, coronal mass ejections (CME), and geomagnetic storms.

tools.name: get_apod
tools.description: Get NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day. Returns image/video with title, explanation, and URLs.
